[Mollified distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0509 1. appi:1.45\group Mollified distance For the standard mollification $r_\varepsilon $ of $r=d(\cdot ,p)$, one has $r_\varepsilon o r$ uniformly on compact sets and $ abla r_\varepsilon o abla r$ uniformly on compact subsets of the complement of the cut locus.
